interface: On B_1 in R^n, n>=3, consider real smooth scalar conductivities in [1/2,3/2], equal to one near the boundary, with integer Sobolev index s>n/2. For a supplied smooth axisymmetric bump psi supported inside B_r away from the rotation axis, the source constructs sigma_k^±=1±a k^-s psi(rho,z) cos(k theta). Their calibrated-coordinate L2 separation is sqrt(2) a ||psi||_2 k^-s, but their nonlinear Dirichlet-to-Neumann response difference in the harmonic-energy operator norm is at most C a k^-s r^k. This is an internally reconstructed proof candidate; quantitative separation modulo a gauge is OPEN.
